thread:
dana_oncall: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: billing-metering-emitter latency spike in us-west. Token counts delayed ~10-30m, some customers receiving overage flags. Investigating.
kevin_sre: I'm on it. Checking emitter and kafka downstream. Any customer hits yet?
maria_billing: Seeing a handful of alerts from the billing monitor: 5 customers with overage flags since 10:03UTC. Totals look inflated vs last hour.
dana_oncall: Confirmed. No deploys in the last 2 hours. Could be emitter batching/backpressure. ingested offsets look okay but emit times lagging.
ingestbot: consumer-lag/us-west topic: lag=0 for consumer-group metering-emitter-consumer; last_commit=5267889980; emit_queue_depth=1200; emit_worker_restarts=2
kevin_sre: emit_queue_depth 1200 is suspicious. Pulling emitter logs now.
kevin_sre: logs snippet: ```WARN metering.emitter - flush delayed: queue_size=1187 flush_time_ms=4300 backoff=2000
ERROR metering.emitter - retrying batch id=0x5f3a`
kevin_sre: Looks like emitter workers are GCing under pressure (old gen spikes). Restarting emitter pod on us-west-01 for triage.
dana_oncall: Go for restart. Meanwhile disable automated overage-notify rule for affected customers to avoid noise: @maria_billing can you toggle?
maria_billing: On it — pausing rule `overage_notify_v2` for customers with tag `beta` and `enterprise-us` (expected ~120 accounts).
cs_omar: Notified the 5 proactively impacted customers via the incident template; asked to ignore transient flags.
kevin_sre: Restart done, new pod started 5267890460. Observability: emit_queue_depth dropping -> 600 -> 180. token lag reducing.
dana_oncall: Good. Can we backfill the ~30m of stashed tokens so billing counts reconcile? What's the safest path?
kevin_sre: Plan: 1) hold alerts (done), 2) stream replays from emitter-stash S3 prefix -> reingest queue with dedupe on batch_id, 3) run a small reconciliation job to compare pre/post counts and surface deltas. Will run in dev-window then prod. Need Maria to approve any customer credit actions after recon.
maria_billing: Approve the reconciliation job. If deltas > 1% for any account, tag for manual review. I'll prepare a credit template.
dana_oncall: Assigning follow-ups: kevin -> replay + reconciliation (ETA 45m), maria -> customer credit template + alert resume (ETA 30m), cs_omar -> keep customers notified. Pagerduty escalation unchanged.
pagerduty_bot: INCIDENT 5267890123 acknowledged by dana_oncall. Severity: P2.
kevin_sre: Kicking off replay job now. Command: `python tools/replay_stash.py --prefix=us-west/emitters/2026-03-17/5267 --dedupe=true --dryrun=false`
kevin_sre: Initial recon shows aggregate token delta ~0.6% across impacted accounts after replaying first 10m of backlog.
dana_oncall: Good signal. Continue replay in 10m batches and watch duplicate suppression. Keep me posted every 10m.
kevin_sre: Will do. tagging this thread with #incident for postmortem notes.
dana_oncall: After replay completes we'll re-enable `overage_notify_v2` and run an integrity check to ensure billing totals are stable. Prepare a short customer-facing summary for CS.
cs_omar: Draft ready, sending to maria for review once recon finalizes.
kevin_sre: Replay complete at 5267890780. Final token delta 0.12% after dedupe. No customers show sustained overage charges.
dana_oncall: Closing mitigation. Resume alerts in 5m. Please add timeline + root cause hypothesis to the incident doc.
maria_billing: Resumed `overage_notify_v2`. Prepared credit memos but not issuing — awaiting manual sign-off.
kevin_sre: Hypothesis: emitter worker GC spikes under high queue depth caused flush delays, leading to temporary emit backlog. Fix: increase emitter worker memory and add backpressure circuit-breaker to reject instead of queuing beyond threshold.
dana_oncall: Thanks team. I'll turn this into an action item list and schedule a postmortem. :white_check_mark:
